title: Short note about heteroskedasticity and White standard errors
summary: A brief overview covering heteroskedasticity in econometric models and the application of White standard errors.

concepts.name: Heteroskedasticity
concepts.summary: Heteroskedasticity occurs when the variance of the error terms differs across observations in a regression model.

concepts.name: Heteroskedasticity-robust standard error
concepts.summary: White standard errors provide a reliable way to conduct inference in the presence of unknown heteroskedasticity.
